name: Serene Guanpole
description: Set the feet on two parallel lines and hold the blade over the space between them.

name: Inferno Ironsweep
description: Slash along the inner track so the blade passes close to the body and cuts at short range.

name: Inferno Guanhook
description: Slash along the outer track with the arms extended to reach the opponent's far flank.

name: Venom Longsweep
description: Hook the opponent's weapon where the two tracks meet and drag it across the body.

name: Steelguan
description: Raise blade and butt together on both tracks so the pole covers two lines of attack.

name: Inferno Bladewheel
description: Cut along one track then switch hands and cut along the other before the first blow lands.

name: Grand Tailspike
description: Run cut and guard along both tracks in one unbroken advance so the opponent faces two lines at once.

name: Tuftdecree
description: Sweep the blade along both tracks in turn so a ring of foes is cut front and back.

name: Guanvoyage
description: Flash along both tracks on a burst of qi so the two lines of cut merge on the opponent's throat.

name: Heavyblade Triumph
description: The school's closing stroke runs two cuts down two tracks at once so the opponent has no line to answer on.

name: Volition Bladecollar
description: Rock the weight from foot to foot like water rolling in a basin and keep the blade swinging easy.

name: Intrepid Guantang
description: Roll the blade over the wrists in a continuous cut that returns to its start.

name: Counterspike Seal
description: Hold the pole at the level of the waterline so blows from below and above both meet the shaft.

name: Unrivaled Polebelly
description: Climb the blade up from the floor of the stance to the rim in a rising slash.

name: Thunderclap Slashdown
description: Roll the hooked blade round an opponent's weapon and pull it out in one smooth turn.

name: Undefiled Crescentback
description: Let a blow spill over the blade's curve and off the far side as water spills over a rim.

name: Imperial Counterspike
description: Sweep low and draw the blade back along the ground to pull the opponent's footing away like a draining basin.

name: Valiant Tailspike
description: Wheel the blade in wide loops that fill the whole basin of the fight with edge and qi.

name: Ironclad Bladewheel
description: Press the blade down on the opponent's weapon and hold it under with rising qi like a flood.

name: Thunderous Polebelly
description: Heave the blade up and over the rim of the fight and release the whole qi field in a downward cut.

name: Valiant Redtassel
description: The school's closing stroke gathers the rolling cuts into a single descending blow that fills the basin of the fight.

name: Nurturing Guanhook
description: Stand with the pole upright before the face then lower it to guard as the exchange opens.

name: Tuftverdict
description: Chop at the point where the opponent's cut and the wielder's cut would cross.

name: Unyielding Guanpole
description: Hold the pole like a bank that turns every blow toward the open side.

name: Vigortuft
description: Step round the opponent in a long bend and bring the blade in behind them.

name: Entropy Slashdown
description: Hook the opponent's wrist and draw it across the centerline with a pull of qi.

name: Royal Bladewheel
description: Slash from the centre of the stance outward with the blade riding a surge of qi.

name: Peal Redtassel
description: Turn the pole in a half circle to throw an attack to the side where the wielder is not.

name: Magnificent Longsweep
description: Press along the opponent's side with a low sweep that drives them toward an obstacle.

name: Season Guantang
description: Join four flowing cuts in a court order so each leads the opponent toward the next.

name: Famed Heavyswing
description: Bring two arcs together at the target's centre and cleave through where they meet.

name: Seasontuft
description: Cross the court in a flash on a burst of qi and judge the opponent with a cut at the far bank.

name: Seasonguan
description: The school's stroke crosses the whole court in one stride and ends the exchange on the far side.

name: Solar Crescentback
description: Hold the blade and the swinging butt as two crescents in a balanced standing pose.

name: Imperial Heavyswing
description: Throw the first crescent from the blade end in a clean overhead arc.

name: Sovereign Bladecollar
description: Throw the second crescent from the opposite side the instant the first has passed.

name: Famed Slashdown
description: Slash once with each crescent so two curved cuts overlap on the same wound.

name: Tuftvow
description: Cross the blade and butt end before the body to stop two attacks at once.

name: Venom Guanpole
description: Hook the opponent's weapon with the blade then with the butt to wrench it from the grip.

name: Seasonhilt
description: Close in with cuts from each crescent in order so the opponent is boxed between two arcs.

name: Tufttriumph
description: Spin with both crescents extended so every foe at the edge of the court takes a cut.

name: Vigorloom
description: Swing both crescents together on a burst of qi so they meet in the opponent's body.

name: Destiny Guantang
description: The school's finale gathers qi into both crescents and releases them as a single paired cut.

name: Parityhilt
description: Stand tall with the blade lifted high as if on a perch above the whole field.

name: Rollcut Triumph
description: Cut in a low fast pass across the opponent's front and recover the blade at once.

name: Stately Bladecollar
description: Hold the pole high and angled to shed blows that fall from the stance's height.

name: Bedrock Redtassel
description: Slash up on a lift of qi that carries the blade above the opponent's guard.

name: Imperious Crescentback
description: Hook the opponent's shaft from above and draw it down and away.

name: Parityguan
description: Meet an attack with the keen edge turned aside so the blow slides off its flat.

name: Royal Slashdown
description: Jab the tip at the opponent's eyes from above to freeze them before the real cut falls.

name: Gloomloom
description: Circle overhead with the blade swinging low and high to herd the opponent into a corner.

name: Magmacrest
description: Wheel the blade in a wide turning cut that passes judgement on every foe within its sweep.

name: Season Redtassel
description: Flash upward out of the opponent's sight on a burst of qi and cut down from where they did not look.

name: Vaunted Heavyswing Verdict
description: The school's verdict stroke gathers qi overhead and drops it through the blade in one descending cut.

name: Solar Guanhook
description: Stand open beneath the sky with the blade extended as far as the arms allow.

name: Unrivaled Guanhook
description: Draw the blade level across the opponent along the line of the horizon.

name: Immaculate Counterspike
description: Raise the pole straight overhead to catch a blow falling from the zenith.

name: Vigor Rollcut
description: Slash along the skyline in a flat rising arc with qi streaming from the edge.

name: Venom Ironsweep
description: Hook the opponent's weapon from far to the side and haul it into the open.

name: Devout Guanpole
description: Turn the pole overhead in a full circle to throw a falling attack wide.

name: Season Tailspike
description: Chain cuts from horizon to zenith in one rising sequence so the blade crosses the whole sky.

name: Demolition Longsweep
description: Wheel the blade through every quarter of the sky so no foe in reach is left uncut.

name: Haemal Tailspike
description: Draw a single unbroken line of qi along the edge and cut through guard and armor.

name: Magma Crescentback
description: The school's stroke draws the core's power into one arc of the blade that spans the whole sky.

name: Benevolent Guantang
description: Stand with the pole's tail planted and the blade slanted toward the wind as if swearing to it.

name: Vigor Counterspike
description: Cut straight along the sworn line without letting the blade veer.

name: Steeltuft
description: Hold the pole fixed and give no ground to a blow that lands on it.

name: Soundless Polebelly
description: Walk the same bearing forward with the blade leading and the stance steady.

name: Thunderclap Guanpole
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and wrench it aside in the direction the wind is blowing.

name: Quenched Guanhook
description: Turn on the heel and slash across the opponent's guard as the wind pushes at the back.

name: Hiltseal
description: Parry with the pole at the sworn angle so each blow slides to the same side.

name: Thrallloom
description: Press the opponent's shaft along the windline and hold it there with steady qi.

name: Symphonic Bladewheel
description: Chain cut guard and thrust along the oath line so no gap opens between them.

name: Inferno Rollcut
description: Reap the open plateau with one wide turning cut driven by the wind at the back.

name: Interstice Ironsweep
description: Flash along the sworn bearing on a burst of qi and land the cut as the oath is spoken.

name: Majestic Bladewheel Triumph
description: The school's oath stroke binds the wielder's breath to the wind and drops one cut along the sworn line.

name: Vigor Redtassel
description: Sight along the pole to set a course on the opponent and stand square to it.

name: Steel Ironsweep
description: Cut along the set course and bring the blade back onto it after the stroke.

name: Hilttroth
description: Brace the pole against a gust and the blow that rides on it.

name: Authoritative Longsweep
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and pull it off its course while the wielder keeps their own.

name: Imperial Polebelly
description: Slash along the held bearing with the gale's push in the arms.

name: Cresttroth
description: Parry with the pole kept on its heading so the attack is turned without losing the line.

name: Tenettuft
description: Chain cuts along one unbroken course so every stroke builds on the line of the last.

name: Tempestuous Rollcut
description: Reap the ground along the course in a wide cut as a gale reaps a field.

name: Pulsar Counterspike
description: Flash along the bearing on a burst of qi and cut without taking the eyes off the course.

name: Splendid Longsweep Triumph
description: The school's final stroke holds the bearing through the gale and lets one cut fall exactly upon it.

name: Vigor Guantang
description: Hold the pole loose in the fingers so the wind can lift the blade as it will.

name: Vigor Polebelly
description: Time the cut to a gust so the blade rides it into the opponent.

name: Prism Bladecollar
description: Spin the pole lightly before the body so the wind veils the guard in whirling edge.

name: Thunderclap Redtassel
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and lift it on a gust of qi so it leaves their guard.

name: Squallcrest
description: Spin the blade in a quick gust and slash across the opponent's open side.

name: Peal Guanhook
description: Flick the pole so fast it whistles and throw an attack off the wielder.

name: Tailspike Crown
description: Chop down with the wind pressing on the blade's back so the edge drives through the guard.

name: Seasoncrest
description: Let the wind carry the crescent from one cut to the next in a flowing chain.

name: Solarguan
description: Sweep the open ground as the wind sweeps it and take every foe who stands within the arc.

name: Pulsarhilt
description: Let the wind carry the blade ahead of the body in a flash so the cut lands before the foot.

name: Bedrock Crescentback
description: The school's stroke lets go the blade into the wind's push and finishes with one wind-carried cut.

name: Vigor Guanhook
description: Turn the blade edge to windward and hold it still as the stance of a sworn edge.

name: Bedrock Ironsweep
description: Cut with the plateau wind at the back and the whole body behind the edge.

name: Prismcrest
description: Shelter behind the turned edge so a strike meets the keenest part of the blade first.

name: Venomhilt
description: Hook the opponent's weapon with the sworn edge and pull it out of line.

name: Vigor Guanpole
description: Meet an attack with a slash on the same line so the blades fall together.

name: Squall Crescentback
description: Parry upward on a gust of qi so the attack is lifted over the wielder's shoulder.

name: Season Heavyblade
description: Chain three cuts with the same edge turned to windward so each follows the last without a pause.

name: Storied Heavyblade
description: Wheel the blade with the plateau wind in wide loops that clear all who stand within reach.

name: Peerless Heavyswing
description: Hold the edge unbroken through a heavy cut with the whole qi field bound behind it.

name: Majestic Bedrock Bladecollar
description: The school's stroke swears the edge to the plateau winds and drops one cut that carries their weight.

name: Bloom Crescentback
description: Set the stance wide and heavy with the blade leaning into an imagined great gale.

name: Steel Rollcut
description: Throw the whole mass of the body and blade into one heavy swing.

name: Sacrosanct Guanpole
description: Brace the pole against both shoulder and hip to hold firm in a storm of blows.

name: Silken Rollcut
description: Advance in heavy paces that each shake the ground like a gale at the door.

name: Pealloom
description: Hook the opponent and haul them forward as the gale hauls a loose sail.

name: Quenched Tailspike
description: Draw the largest arc the arms can swing and let qi follow the edge round it.

name: Enshrined Redtassel
description: Turn the pole in a heavy circle that throws aside a barrage of blows.

name: Intrepid Polebelly
description: Press the whole weight of the body down the pole and the edge to crush the opponent's guard.

name: Tenetloom
description: Throw heavy cuts one after another so each gives the next the full weight of the gale.

name: Bedrock Heavyswing
description: Wheel the blade in heavy loops that reap the whole ground like a great gale.

name: Pulsarloom
description: Loose the whole qi field and flash the blade out in one uncaged heavy cut.

name: Matchless Magma Bladewheel
description: The school's stroke gathers the full mass of a great gale into the blade and drops it in one cut.

name: Bloomguan
description: Stand still with the blade lowered in the stance taken before the final oath is spoken.

name: Sovereign Guantang
description: Draw the blade up and across in the open wind with no hurry in the stroke.

name: Statute Bladecollar
description: Hold the pole before the heart in the last guard that yields nothing.

name: Vaunted Slashdown
description: Slash with qi bound to the sworn word so the cut cannot be turned from its line.

name: Ruling Slashdown
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and drag it along the sworn line away from the body.

name: Undefiled Guanhook
description: Parry level with the horizon so a blow from any side slides past.

name: Sigilguan
description: Take one breath and press the opponent's shaft down with it held until the oath is ready.

name: Counterspike Banner
description: Chain cuts toward the final stroke so each one is sworn before it is thrown.

name: Triumphant Polebelly
description: Turn once in the open wind with the blade reaping a full circle at chest height.

name: Ironsweep Triumph
description: Cut once with the whole qi field and let the wind carry the oath through the target.

name: Unrivaled Steel Longsweep
description: The school's last stroke gathers the core's power into one sworn cut that ends the exchange.
